profile.reading:
TierPoint operates its Spokane-market data centers in Liberty Lake, Washington, which sits within Spokane County east of the city of Spokane. TierPoint's current site lists two separate facility groups here: a combined SPO01/SPO02 building at 23403 East Mission Avenue, spanning more than 32,000 total square feet with more than 21,000 square feet of raised floor and backed by four 1.25-megawatt plus six 800-kilowatt redundant generators, and a smaller SPO03 building at 23017 East Mission Avenue, spanning more than 16,500 total square feet with more than 9,900 square feet of raised floor and two 2.5-megawatt redundant generators. Because this single map record could not be confidently matched to one specific building group this session, both are documented here rather than guessing. Notably, this is one of the few TierPoint sites in this research batch with a directly sourced acquisition date: TierPoint's own leadership page states the company acquired a pre-existing, identically named company called TierPoint Spokane in 2012, though the page does not specify whether that 2012 date applies to both current building groups or only the original facility later expanded. Both facility groups carry TierPoint's standard SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II (including HITRUST), HIPAA, PCI-DSS, GLBA, and ISO 27001 compliance package. TierPoint, headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, was formed in 2010 and now operates roughly 40 data centers across 20 US markets. As is standard industry practice, tenant identities are not publicly disclosed.

TierPoint has also grown through significant recent capital raises beyond its acquisition history: a 320 million dollar equity round in April 2020 led by Argo Infrastructure Partners, Wafra, and Macquarie Capital Principal Finance alongside existing investors, followed by Argo's 500 million dollar investment in February 2022 that made it TierPoint's largest single equity investor, and a further increase to Argo's ownership and capital commitment announced in December 2025. Jerry Kent, TierPoint's chairman and chief executive, also co-founded Charter Communications in 1993 and Cequel III in 2002, the entity that manages TierPoint, giving the company leadership deep roots in the broader telecommunications and cable infrastructure industry beyond data centers specifically.

reading.body:
TierPoint operates two building groups at Liberty Lake in Spokane County, Washington. The larger combined facility (SPO01/SPO02) spans more than 32,000 square feet with more than 21,000 square feet of raised floor, backed by 8.5 megawatts of generator capacity. The smaller facility (SPO03) spans more than 16,500 square feet with more than 9,900 square feet of raised floor, backed by 5 megawatts of generator capacity. The record could not confidently match these buildings to a single address, so both are documented here. TierPoint acquired the original Spokane facility in 2012 but has not published which building or buildings date to that acquisition.

The campus certifications qualify it to host workloads requiring SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II compliance, HIPAA regulated data, HITRUST certification, PCI-DSS payment processing, GLBA financial records, and ISO 27001 information security management. Tenant identities are not disclosed. Published power capacity at the campus is not stated, so the facilities' capability to host AI training workloads cannot be estimated from the specifications provided.

This campus ranks third by published megawatts among the 46 mapped facilities in Washington state, though only two facilities in the state publish power figures. The context does not indicate whether this Spokane location or any part of it is under active expansion or contraction, or what share of its raised floor is currently in use. The campus sits in a market without published grid constraints from this research site's available data.
